In this role, we are looking for a highly experienced and hands-on AI Lead Autonomous to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role will be responsible for driving the Autonomous Framework as a program and translating prioritized AI use cases into delivered, validated outcomes. The candidate will directly contribute to AI solution design, prototyping and delivery while providing technical leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring strong execution discipline, stakeholder management and the ability to drive outcomes across product, platform, architecture, technology partners and pilot customers. The role will also contribute to AI-led margin acceleration initiatives and provide delivery and feasibility inputs into AI use-case prioritization. As the organization scales, the role will have an opportunity to build and lead a team of AI engineers.
The work model for the role is: Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for
  • Drive AI-led margin acceleration and hands-on AI delivery by identifying high-impact AI opportunities and directly contributing to solution design, prototyping, development and implementation using Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications.
  • Lead Autonomous Framework execution and program visibility by establishing the operating cadence, managing milestones, dependencies and releases, maintaining execution visibility, and providing concise, decision-ready updates on progress, risks, blockers and required actions.
  • Drive execution discipline, technical feasibility and stakeholder coordination by defining clear objectives, scope, success criteria and decision gates for AI initiatives, managing cross-functional dependencies, addressing risks and blockers, and providing input into prioritization and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Build technical capability and partner alignment by acting as a senior AI SME, collaborating with architects, product teams, platform teams and partners such as Microsoft and Cognite, and progressively building and leading a small team of AI engineers as the function scales.


Qualifications for the role:
  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, data science or analytics, including 7+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI and/or Classical Machine Learning.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in LLMs, RAG, MCP, agentic orchestration, agentic harnesses and agentic architecture, with proven experience delivering AI solutions in industrial domains.
  • Proven experience developing Classical ML and Neural Network models, with strong knowledge of MLOps and cloud/edge deployment.

  • Strong understanding of AI solution architecture, experimentation, prototyping and production deployment, with the ability to translate business priorities into technically feasible and executable AI workstreams.

Role Summary

You set the architecture and standards, decide when an agent is the right answer and when it is not, and ensure what the teams build is secure, grounded, cost-aware, and maintainable. You stay technical enough to prototype and challenge a design, but your primary output is direction, standards, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end architecture for agentic AI solutions, from use-case qualification through to a documented target design.
  • Make the key platform decisions: Copilot Studio versus M365 Copilot agents versus pro-code (Azure AI Foundry / SDK), low-code versus pro-code orchestration, and where each is justified.
  • Define grounding and knowledge architecture: which sources, how they are indexed and secured, and how retrieval quality is maintained over time.
  • Design the security and identity model for agents, including Entra ID, least-privilege access, connector governance, and data boundaries.
  • Establish governance for agentic AI: DLP policies, environment strategy, ALM, responsible AI guardrails, monitoring, and cost management for consumption/messaging.
  • Provide architectural governance and design review over the agents that senior developers and teams deliver.
  • Advise clients and internal stakeholders on agentic AI roadmaps, feasibility, and effort/complexity trade-offs, and support proposals and SOWs with credible designs.
  • Anticipate risks around accuracy, data exposure, licensing/consumption cost, and long-term supportability, and design around them.

Must-Have Skills

  • Architecture-level command of Copilot Studio and the broader Microsoft agent ecosystem (M365 Copilot extensibility, agents, connectors).
  • Deep Power Platform expertise including environment strategy, ALM, and DLP/governance.
  • Strong grasp of grounding, retrieval, prompt orchestration, and the practical limits of generative AI.
  • Solid Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, and M365 security/identity knowledge.
  • Ability to produce clear architecture artifacts: solution designs, data-flow and grounding diagrams, and governance frameworks.
  • Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, and consumption/cost models for agent workloads.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to reason about RAG at the design level: retrieval quality, chunking strategy, and knowledge-source architecture across the estate.
  • Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and pro-code agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain) for hybrid and fully pro-code solutions.
  • Python for pro-code agent and integration scenarios where low-code is not sufficient.
  • Azure integration services (Functions, Logic Apps, API Management) for agents that reach beyond M365.
  • SPFx / Power Apps for custom agent surfaces and embedding.
  • SharePoint Online and on-premises (2019/SPSE) knowledge for enterprise content grounding and hybrid scenarios.
  • PowerShell for M365 administration and automation.

Experience & Qualifications

Experience: Typically 10+ years across M365 / Power Platform, with demonstrable architecture ownership and real agentic AI or Copilot delivery.

Certifications: Architect-level certifications (PL-600, Azure/M365 architect credentials, and Copilot/agent-focused ones) are strongly preferred.

Contract Risk Lead

Function: Delivery Excellence, Quality and Risk Management at GDS consulting

Job level: Associate Director / Senior Manager

Role Summary

The Contract Risk Lead is responsible for assessing, governing, and monitoring contractual, regulatory, privacy, security, operational, AI, and delivery risks associated with GDS-supported engagements. Contract Risk Assessment Governance

  • Implement best practices to reduce complexity, improve scalability, reusability, security and increase efficiency through standardisation
  • Own AI agent evaluation and governance practices assessing agent behavior, tool use, and outcomes at design time and runtime, and testing/simulating workflows against real-world scenarios, exceptions, and edge cases before and after production deployment
  • Provide support in performing QA testing and supporting User Acceptance Testing as needed whilst establishing the broader capability

The Candidate
The successful candidate will combine the ability to lead multiple teams/workstreams with project management skills and prior experience delivering the benefits of transformational change.
The candidate needs a demonstrable and highly commercial mind-set, strong financial acumen in addition to excellent listening and communication skills. A logical, structured approach to problem solving and common sense are key.
Experience
  • Extensive professional experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm and/or with a firm with a well-established transformation agenda
  • Previous roles include Technical Delivery responsibility in a global company with similar size to JLL
  • At least 8+ years of experience which includes RPA, Gen AI, prompt engineering, Agentic AI, and programming
  • RPA APA platform experience: extensive experience with Automation Anywhere both classic A360 (Control Room, bot development) and the Agentic Process Automation (APA) platform (AI Agent Studio, Automator AI, universal orchestration) plus Power Platform, with certifications
  • Hands-on agentic AI experience: designing, building, and deploying AI agents goal-driven agent design, multi-agent orchestration, tool/API integration not just conceptual exposure to Gen AI
  • Experience with Gen AI tools/tech implementations, including LLM-based prompting, RAG, and enterprise Gen AI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI)
  • Preferred: exposure to AWS Bedrock AgentCore or another managed agentic automation/orchestration platform
  • Direct experience of major international business transformation projects
  • Excellent analytical and program management skills are essential
  • Diverse industry and functional backgrounds gained through consulting or elsewhere
  • Understanding of or exposure to global real estate markets preferred but not essential
  • Ability to effectively design, gain alignment and successfully execute significant transformation change initiatives from project start to finish
  • Ability to training / transfer learning and skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Needs to demonstrate significant credibility in having previously delivered Automation, Gen AI, and agentic design and implementation programmes
Technical Skills
  • Must have experience in Solution Design, Development, Testing, Run Support, Maintenance, Incident Management and Change Management across RPA, Gen AI, and agentic solutions
  • Control room administration knowledge across both A360 Control Room and APA orchestration/administration
  • Experience with Process Analysis, Design, and Implementation, Business and Technical requirements, Problem-Solving, and Testing, including UAT and Bug fixes
  • Experience in handling Change Requests and Incidents, and experience in change management process
  • Knowledge of SDLC and Agile development
  • Good working experience with all types of applications and APIs for RPAs
  • Good working experience with document automation and other OCR tools

  • Comfortable leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance product analysis, backlog refinement, documentation quality, insight generation and delivery efficiency, while maintaining accountability, ownership and professional judgement for all outputs.

jobDescription:
Meet the Team

We are the Supply Chain Transformation AI Team within Cisco s Supply Chain Operations. We are a diverse, fast-moving group of AI engineers and data scientists who collaborate directly with Product Operations. We don t just analyze data; we transform it into actionable intelligence. By building advanced AI solutions, we empower our NPI (New Product Introduction) PMs, Product, and Test Engineering teams to anticipate market shifts, optimize workflows, and meet the evolving demands of our product lifecycle.

Your Impact

You will lead the architectural direction and development of high-impact AI/ML solutions, transforming complex, ambiguous supply chain challenges into measurable business outcomes.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Architecture: Translate high-level business objectives into scalable, rigorous data science projects.
  • Advanced AI/ML Development: Architect and deploy sophisticated models, including predictive analytics, LLM-powered applications, and agentic workflows.
  • Technical Leadership: Drive methodological rigor in experimental design, model evaluation, and statistical validation.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with AI Engineers to ensure seamless integration from research to production.
  • Innovation & Research: Pilot cutting-edge methodologies (e.g., Agentic Framework, RAG, fine-tuning, graph analytics) to maintain a competitive edge.
  • Mentorship & Governance: Foster a culture of technical excellence and code reproducibility while ensuring all models adhere to enterprise ethics, bias mitigation, and interpretability standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of professional experience in data science, analytics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated expertise in statistical analysis
  • Proven track record of applying correlation analysis and advanced statistical techniques in a business context.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, self-driven, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Generative AI & LLM Proficiency
    • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production
    • Experience with Agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration
    • Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication patterns, and agent integration frameworks
    • Experience building RAG pipelines including embeddings, retrieval strategies, reranking, context management, and evaluation
    • Strong prompt engineering skills including prompt design, structured outputs, guardrails, and workflow optimization
    • Experience working with vector databases and semantic retrieval systems
    • Advanced Statistical & ML Expertise: Deep understanding of supervised/unsupervised learning, time-series analysis, and optimization techniques.
    • Experience in fine-tuning LLMs, advanced prompt engineering, and evaluating AI systems (eval frameworks, human-in-the-loop validation).
  • Programming & Data Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL. Familiarity with modern data engineering tools (Spark, Snowflake, or similar).
  • System Design: Ability to design end-to-end data pipelines that feed into production AI systems.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master s or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
  • Proven track record of deploying models that have directly influenced supply chain or operational efficiency.
  • Experience with MLOps practices (MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar) to manage the model lifecycle.
  • Experience working with large-scale, unstructured datasets and multi-modal data.

Why Cisco

At Cisco, we re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era and beyond. We ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Overview: Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as India's no. 1 RPM Company.

We are seeking visionary individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. As a part of our dynamic team, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with top healthcare providers in the country, applying AI-powered RPM solutions to tackle some of the most pressing challenges in healthcare - enhancing staff efficiency, improving patient outcomes, and pioneering the next generation of care models.

We're hiring a Supply Chain Lead to own our supply chain end-to-end "Procurement, Manufacturing, and Logistics" - in a regulated medical device environment. This is a hands-on role: you will lead the teams, own processes, budgets and track spends, drive demand planning, and keep every process audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement

  • Demand planning - lead demand planning in partnership with Sales, translating the sales forecast and pipeline into a material and component procurement plan.

  • Supplier onboarding quality - qualify and onboard suppliers via a risk-classified Approved Supplier List (ASL) process; drive incoming quality control (IQC); and negotiate favorable delivery schedules, pricing, and payment / credit terms.

  • Audit documentation CAPAs - own supplier management documentation for audits (supplier files, quality agreements, evaluation and re-evaluation records) and raise CAPAs against non-conformances, driving root-cause analysis and effectiveness checks to closure

  • Team management - lead, prioritize, and mentor the procurement team.

  • Budgets - prepare and track procurement budgets, monitoring budget vs. actuals and driving cost-savings initiatives.

  • Audits - participate in inventory audits and QMS audits, keeping procurement records audit-ready at all times.

Manufacturing

  • Manufacturing partners - onboard and manage contract manufacturers / EMS partners end-to-end apart from inhouse manufacturing. Enforce quality control, and negotiate favorable delivery and payment terms in support of production.

  • Efficiency output - track manufacturing efficiency and output against plan, resolving bottlenecks between suppliers and the production line.

  • Stock visibility - build dashboards and reports giving the Sales team real-time visibility into stock levels and availability.

  • COGS - track COGS for each production cycle and surface variances against standard cost.

  • Team management - manage the manufacturing team

  • Audits - participate in inventory audits and QMS audits.

  • Engineering feedback loop - review field tickets and failure reports, translating recurring issues into structured inputs for the Engineering team to drive design / process improvements.

Logistics (Domestic International)

  • Distribution, imports exports - lead the logistics team covering domestic distribution, imports, and exports.

  • 3PL warehousing - onboard and manage 3PL partners, evaluate zone-wise utilization, and stand up local / regional warehousing where the network requires it.

  • Cost - own logistics cost (freight, customs, warehousing) and drive it down against KPIs.

  • ERP tracking - set up ERP modules for shipment tracking and end-to-end visibility.

  • TATs - define and maintain shipment turnaround times (TATs) and hold the network accountable to them.

Cross-Functional Systems

  • ERP dashboards - set up and administer ERP workflows (IQC gating, NC / CAPA tracking, supplier status, inventory, shipment modules) and build management dashboards for spend, COGS, inventory turns, on-time delivery, and supplier performance.

  • Consolidated budget - own the consolidated supply chain budget

  • Regulatory audits - serve as a supply chain point-of-contact in ISO 13485, CE (MDR), and FDA audits, partnering closely with QARA.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in supply chain / operations across procurement, manufacturing, and logistics

  • Proven experience managing teams and managing spends / budgets

  • Strong supplier onboarding and negotiation track record (delivery terms, payment / credit terms, quality).

  • Hands-on ERP experience - setting up or administering procurement, inventory, and logistics modules.

  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable building dashboards and reporting on COGS, inventory, and KPIs.
